title: Rebbec Seals the Gateway
summary: Rebbec makes a final sacrifice to separate Dominaria from Phyrexia.
narrative: As the Thran civilization collapsed, Rebbec recognized the danger posed by Yawgmoth and his Phyrexian domain.
Her decision to seal the gateway prevented Yawgmoth from freely returning to Dominaria, though the consequences of his rise would endure.
